sources.cite: Mayer, R. E., & Fiorella, L. (2014). Principles for Reducing Extraneous Processing in Multimedia Learning (Cambridge Handbook of Multimedia Learning, 2nd ed.)

sources.cite: Mayer, R. E., Heiser, J., & Lonn, S. (2001). Cognitive constraints on multimedia learning: When presenting more material results in less understanding. Journal of Educational Psychology, 93(1), 187-198.
sources.finding: Empirically shows that adding interesting-but-irrelevant ('seductive') details to a presentation lowered retention and transfer test performance — direct support for the claim that a longer 'covers more' deck harms, rather than helps, the audience's takeaway.
